name: Frigate cameras
description: Live video or regularly refreshed pictures from one or more Frigate cameras.

options.label: Frigate address
options.help: Frigate's unauthenticated port, reachable from both the Vital Signs server and the Pi, for example http://192.168.1.30:5000

options.label: Cameras to show, one per line (blank for all)
options.help: Camera names as in your Frigate config. They are shown in the order listed.

choices.label: All cameras at once, in a grid
One camera at a time, in turn

options.label: Seconds per camera (one at a time)

choices.label: Live video (falls back to pictures if a stream will not play)
Pictures, refreshed regularly (lightest on the Pi)
